releaseNotes: Fixed automatic in-app update checks by serving update-manifest.json from GitHub Releases with a raw main branch fallback.
Every fresh app launch now checks for new versions silently when online without interrupting offline use.
Shows in-app What's New dialog with one-tap Update Now download, SHA-256 + RSA-2048 signature verification, and automatic app relaunch after installation.
Resumes pending update installation automatically after granting 'Install unknown apps' permission.
